gold.text: Users can enter income and expenses, assign them categories, items and payment methods, and mark their status (such as paid, pending payment, expected payment).
Users can use filtering and sorting features (such as by category, time, status, and amount) to flexibly view transaction records.
Users can search for transactions by entering a text field.
The system can correctly generate and display historical cash flow charts, and the chart data is consistent with the entered transaction records.
The system can generate a forecast view of cash balances for a future period based on the entered expected payments and recurring items.
Users can create custom views for specific business areas (such as marketing, operations, or specific customers) and save the combination of filter criteria and display fields for that view.
Users can quickly switch between different custom views, and each view can correctly display customized transaction summary information for the corresponding business area.
When a user modifies the transaction status, the system can update relevant statistics, charts, and forecast data in real time to maintain consistency.
When validating transaction data, the system can prevent obviously invalid inputs (such as "paid" records for future dates, negative income amounts, etc.) and provide clear prompts.
When creating a custom view, the same name cannot appear twice.
When creating a custom view, users cannot create a view if the view name, associated business domain, or filter criteria (fixed category/project/customer) are empty.
